text:
maria-se: Quick async check-in on the Meridian enterprise trial integration timeline. We promised Meridian a demo environment by 2025-08-01 — want to confirm owners and blockers.

kevin-se: I can own API contract + example integration. Need SSO details from Meridian and a stable model variant to pin.

ashley-ps: I have the contract template ready. Meridian asked for SAML SSO and an allowlist for inference endpoints. Waiting on their IdP metadata.

maria-se: @kevin-se @ashley-ps owner matrix: API + sample code = kevin, SAML + onboarding = ashley, infra/staging = sam-ops, data mapping & success criteria = tess-eng. Agree? :+1:

sam-ops: ping — staging infra can be ready by 2025-07-25 if we get network IPs and KMS access window. Two blockers: (1) Meridian requires whitelisted egress to their webhook host, (2) we need a cert for the private endpoint.

kevin-se: For the model pin, can we offer rwd-3b-quant for initial perf? It hits their latency SLO in our perf table (p50 ~ 90ms). If they need lower latency we can switch to rwd-7b but cost goes up.

ashley-ps: Documenting success criteria here so we can sign off: 1) end-to-end demo with their sample dataset (>=95% of intents routed correctly), 2) p95 inference latency < 300ms for interactive flows, 3) no data egress outside approved endpoints, 4) RBAC + audit logs enabled.

maria-se: Good list. @tess-eng can you own the intent mapping tests + a small eval harness? Prefer lightweight pytest-based checks we can run during onboarding.

tess-eng: Yep — will create a repo with test vectors and a CI job that runs against staging. ETA for initial vectors: 2025-07-20.

kevin-se: Sharing sample curl for the demo app; put in the docs:

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b-quant","input":"Summarize the following..."}'
```

sam-ops: On the network side, Meridian asked for a static egress IP range: 34.88.120.0/24. We can NAT from that pool but need approval from infra security for exceptions.

maria-se: Noted. @deploy-bot quick status: any scheduled infra maintenance between 2025-07-20 and 2025-08-02?

deploy-bot: No maintenance windows scheduled in that range. Next planned capacity update is 2025-08-15.

ashley-ps: Blocking ask to Meridian: send SAML metadata + one sample user for onboarding, and confirm which model variant they want pinned for the trial (rwd-3b-quant or rwd-7b).

kevin-se: Also we need the example webhook payloads for their downstream system so we can map events. If they have a schema, drop it in the shared drive.

maria-se: Action items recap (short):
- kevin-se: API samples + contract by 2025-07-18
- tess-eng: eval vectors + CI by 2025-07-20
- sam-ops: staging infra + cert + NAT by 2025-07-25
- ashley-ps: SSO onboarding once IdP metadata received; prep runbook by 2025-07-22
- meridian: provide SAML metadata, sample user, webhook schema, and model preference by 2025-07-15

ashley-ps: I'll email Meridian with the req list and copy this thread.

kevin-se: One more note — if Meridian asks for PBKDF2 or custom auth header, call it out now. Otherwise standard bearer token + SAML session is fine.

maria-se: Thanks all. I'll follow up in two days with a status pulse. If anyone hits blockers, drop here and we'll escalate. :rocket:
